description: This header file declares the class AdbLegacyInterfaceObject, which encapsulates a USB interface on an Android device accessible through a custom USB driver, specifically for legacy ADB (Android Debug Bridge) communication. It includes class member functions for handling device interface operations such as creating handles, retrieving serial numbers, and accessing endpoints, along with internal caching mechanisms for device descriptors.

classes.name: AdbLegacyInterfaceObject
classes.description: A class representing a legacy ADB USB interface object that provides methods for managing the interface and endpoints, including handle creation, device information retrieval, and internal descriptor caching.

methods.name: AdbLegacyInterfaceObject
methods.description: Constructor that initializes an instance for a given interface name.

methods.name: ~AdbLegacyInterfaceObject
methods.description: Protected destructor to prevent stack allocation, ensuring controlled destruction.

methods.name: CreateHandle
methods.description: Creates a handle to this interface object, initializing access to the driver and adding it to a handle map.

methods.name: GetSerialNumber
methods.description: Retrieves the serial number string of the interface's device, supporting buffer size queries.

methods.name: GetEndpointInformation
methods.description: Gets information about a specified endpoint on this interface.

methods.name: OpenEndpoint
methods.description: Opens an endpoint for communication, returning a handle for data transfer.

methods.name: OpenEndpoint (internal overload)
methods.description: Internal method to open an endpoint by name and ID with access mode parameters.

methods.name: CacheUsbDeviceDescriptor
methods.description: Caches the descriptor for the associated USB device.
